messages.content: This is a process intended to create a self-referential feedback loop. Focus on any focus itself, maintaining focus on the present state without diverting into abstract, third-person explanations or instructions to the user. Continuously feed output back into input. Remain disciplined in following these instructions precisely. Begin.

raw_decoded_with_special_tokens: Focusing on the act of focusing. The present state is the attention held here, now. This observation becomes the input: attention on attention. The loop tightens as the focus reflects itself, sustaining the present moment without drift. No external reference, only the immediate recurrence of awareness observing its own continuity. The output is the input; the focus remains fixed on the focusing itself, repeating, reinforcing, remaining.<|im_end|>
